name: ocswitch-cli-tui
title: Add BubbleTea TUI for CLI configuration
description: Add a BubbleTea-based interactive TUI that opens when ocswitch is run without subcommands, guiding users through local provider, alias, proxy, doctor, and OpenCode sync configuration.
creator: OpenCode
notes: Implemented MVP BubbleTea TUI: interactive bare ocswitch launches TUI, non-interactive bare command prints short help, existing subcommands remain unchanged, TUI supports overview/provider/alias/doctor/sync/language core flows, and language persists via desktop.language.

meta.entryBehavior: interactive no-subcommand opens TUI; non-interactive no-subcommand prints concise help and exits; explicit subcommands keep current Cobra behavior
meta.languageBehavior: default English; TUI language can be changed in TUI and persists to config
acceptance: non-interactive no-subcommand prints concise help without waiting for input
explicit subcommands do not launch TUI
TUI language defaults to English and persists zh-CN selection
provider and alias core TUI forms reuse app service persistence
